_README: Cortex hooks for Claude Code. Installed as a plugin, hooks/hooks.json is used automatically. To use these from ~/.claude/settings.json instead, copy the 'hooks' object and replace ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with the absolute path of your cortex checkout. The session hook resolves the config root through the shared resolver and tells you plainly when it cannot see it (for example in a cloud session).

hooks.command: echo '[cortex] Session ending — make sure observations were committed to your Cortex memory (see /remember).'

_setup.step_2: Copy the 'hooks' object above and merge it into your settings file
_setup.step_3: Add INSTRUCTIONS.md content to your CLAUDE.md (this is required — hooks alone are not enough)
_setup.step_4: Run: python3 scripts/configure_cortex.py   (creates ~/cortex-root and the shared pointer)
_setup.step_5: Start a new Claude Code session
_setup.minimal_setup: If you don't want hooks, just add INSTRUCTIONS.md content to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. The always-on behaviors are instruction-driven and work without hooks.
